scope: Evidence review and documented approximation ledger for Inferno Dragon's independent beam lifecycle.

sources.title: New Levels & Balance Changes!
sources.finding: Supercell states Inferno Dragon's beam ramp-up was slowed by 0.2 seconds.

sources.title: Full Patch Notes
sources.finding: Supercell changes Inferno Dragon beam cooldown from 0.5 to 0.6 seconds.

sources.title: Inferno Dragon | Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.finding: The consulted table gives stage boundaries 1.7 and 3.2 seconds and stage DPS, including TH18 L12 90/182/1,820, but no version-pinned target-loss or collision contract.

established: Inferno Dragon has a three-stage beam and a 0.6-second cooldown.
Its cited 1.7/3.2-second stage boundaries differ from the Inferno Tower's 1.5/5.25-second contract.
The secondary table supplies L12 TH18 stage DPS 90, 182 and 1,820.
unresolved: No located version-identified source defines target-loss/reset, Freeze/Rage, movement, range measurement, altitude, beam hit timing or splash behavior for the frozen version.
The primary sources do not publish the per-level stage table or exact post-change boundaries.
decision: Enabled as core_supported_secondary_partial through the additive Inferno Dragon reference. Core uses its independent 1.7/3.2-second stage contract and the sourced 0.6-second cooldown; direct beam impact and reset-on-target-loss are documented deterministic approximations, not claimed game-exact rules.
